prompt: Here's a multi-model MD trajectory of a helical peptide. Turn it into an ~8-second MP4 (H.264, has to play in PowerPoint) showing the trajectory playing as a rainbow-colored cartoon, and also export one 300-dpi PNG of a representative frame from the middle of the trajectory.
assertions: An MP4 deliverable exists, larger than 100 KB

The MP4 duration is between 6 and 12 seconds (user asked ~8s; frame-driven duration must be lengthened via playback speed)
The video actually animates: a frame extracted at 25% of the timeline differs from one at 75%
A PNG deliverable exists at 2000+ pixels on its long side showing the peptide cartoon
